notes.title: Combat manual
notes.notes: [p]Earlier you could miss all the fun from the combat, because there was almost no training, except just one hint in the introduction.[/p][p][/p][p]Now,[/p][list][*][p]Added a combo list in the menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a detailed tip on diferrent attack types, complex attacks and combos at the start of the gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded a character menu interface. The indicators are displayed in more detail.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a more detailed display of the damage you deal. The damage type is now displayed.[/p][/*][/list][p]Also:[/p][list][*][p]Added an autosave right after the introduction.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lags in several script points on the level.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance on the last arena a bit changed in favor of the player.[/p][/*][/list]
